# vendor/

Third-party kits kept for reference. Everything here except this file is
git-ignored: fetch them by hand, read them, port ideas, and check each kit's
licence before reusing any of its code or text. A kit without a licence is
all rights reserved: read it, never copy from it.

Note each kit you add here, with its source, licence and what it's for.

## motion-graphics

- Source: https://github.com/Barty-Bart/motion-graphics
  (`git clone https://github.com/Barty-Bart/motion-graphics vendor/motion-graphics`)
- Licence: MIT, © 2026 Bart. Its sound effects are CC0 (`skills/sound-effects/LICENSES.md`);
  the Mixkit sounds and music it fetches at runtime may not be redistributed.
- For: ideas behind the high-energy hype, calm product demo and one-take journey
  archetypes (`templates/shotlist.md`, `docs/techniques.md`), the beat-grid check
  in `@motion-kit/audio` and the sound-source licence check in `motion-review`.
  Its skills are not installed here: they render their own HTML pages outside the
  kit's engines, gates and rules. Its `motion-broll` and `object-separation`
  skills live on in [broll-kit](https://github.com/galangaulia/broll-kit).
